name: AgentAura
description: Sync QwenPaw agent lifecycle events to ESP32 Ring Light hardware.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 将 QwenPaw 智能体生命周期事件实时同步到 ESP32 环形灯硬件。
description_i18n.en-US: Sync QwenPaw agent lifecycle events to ESP32 Ring Light hardware.

author: AlpacaKnight

transport.title: Connection Transport
transport.description: How to talk to the device: http (WiFi REST), udp (WiFi datagram), or serial (USB CDC)

host.title: Device Host
host.description: ESP32 IP address or hostname (for http/udp). e.g. 192.168.1.100 or ringlight.local

port.title: Port
port.description: HTTP port (default 80) or UDP port (default 8888). Ignored for serial.

serial_port.title: Serial Port
serial_port.description: COM port (Windows) or /dev/tty* path (macOS/Linux). Only used when transport=serial.

baud.title: Baud Rate
baud.description: Serial baud rate. Firmware default is 115200.

auto_discover.title: Auto discover device on startup (UDP broadcast)

debounce_ms.title: State debounce (ms) - skip repeated identical states within this window

auth_token.title: Auth Token
auth_token.description: Bearer token sent in the Authorization header for HTTP requests. Leave empty for devices without authentication.
